notes.title: Side-scrolling, soul-shifting sandbox action adventure AMEDAMA—due for release in 2023!
notes.notes:
AMEDAMA is a side-scrolling, soul-shifting sandbox action adventure brought to life with a striking new 2D style!
Due for release on Steam in 2023! 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38202714/734e5d3fd556510a9d9c28609ff87b6600b59448.jpg[/img]

AMEDAMA is a brand new game brought to you by IzanagiGames and ACQUIRE, with character design from lack (Fate/Grand Order, Touken Ranbu), and music from Yuko Komiyama (Monster Hunter series).

▼Add to your Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2411980/__AMEDAMA/

▼AMEDAMA global Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/amedama_global

Stay tuned for more announcements and updates!

notes.title: The Yurukill Steam Release 1st Anniversary Sale is now underway!
notes.notes:
The Yurukill Steam Release 1st Anniversary Sale is now underway!

To celebrate a year having passed since the release of Yurukill: The Calumniation Games on July 7th 2022, we’re holding a massive sale! Both Yurukill and the Original Soundtrack DLC—featuring all 45 tracks from the game—are currently 40% off!

The bundle discount also applies, so purchasing the game and the soundtrack together qualifies for an additional 10% discount!

Don’t miss out on this very special chance!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733840/_/][b]Check out the Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Steam page! (Demo also available!)[/b][/url]

Swing by the IzanagiGames Discord server, then head over to our Steam publisher page and give us a follow! These are the best places to keep up to date with our latest sales, new releases and exclusive information!

notes.title: Update: 06/27/2022
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are aware that some users are experiencing an issue in which the demo won’t start. To help us investigate and try and reproduce the issue, if we could trouble you to let us know the following details when posting a comment/feedback, that would be highly appreciated!
This also applies to other bug reports in general!

- OS version
- The timing at which you encountered the issue
- Graphics card
- Processor
- RAM

Thank you.

-IzanagiGames
